verdict.rationale: The Apple M4 Max is a hardware system-on-chip. An interactive API reference with runnable examples is a software developer-documentation capability, so the story is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence mentions related Apple software (Metal, MLX, PyTorch backends), but none of it shows the chip itself shipping an interactive API reference, so the exception that would make the axis apply is not met.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
